turns.customer: My son dropped the Firefly headlamp from order #1074 on the rocks at camp and the lens shattered. Can I get a refund for it?
turns.reply: I’m sorry to hear the headlamp was damaged. Accidental damage after delivery isn’t covered for a refund or return. A human support agent will follow up by email about a warranty claim. Your ticket number is ESC-41 and you should hear back within one business day. Thanks for understanding.
